description: This file defines interfaces for managing container runtimes, containers, pod sandboxes, container statistics, and images in the Kubernetes CRI API.

classes.name: RuntimeVersioner
classes.description: Interface for retrieving runtime name, version, and API version.

classes.name: ContainerManager
classes.description: Interface for managing containers, including creation, start, stop, removal, status, resource updates, command execution, log management, checkpointing, and event retrieval.

classes.name: PodSandboxManager
classes.description: Interface for managing pod sandboxes, including creation, stopping, removal, status, listing, port forwarding, and resource updates.

classes.name: ContainerStatsManager
classes.description: Interface for retrieving container and pod sandbox statistics.

classes.name: RuntimeService
classes.description: Main interface for container runtime, combining versioning, container, sandbox, stats management, configuration, status, and connection management.

classes.name: ImageManagerService
classes.description: Interface for managing container images, including listing, status, pulling, removal, filesystem info, and connection management.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the runtime name, version, and API version.

methods.name: CreateContainer
methods.description: Creates a new container within a specified PodSandbox.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a specified container.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container with a timeout.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a specified container.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Lists containers based on filters.

methods.name: ContainerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a container.

methods.name: UpdateContainerResources
methods.description: Updates container resources synchronously.

methods.name: ExecSync
methods.description: Executes a command in a container, returning stdout and stderr.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Prepares a streaming endpoint to execute a command in a container.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Prepares a streaming endpoint to attach to a running container.

methods.name: ReopenContainerLog
methods.description: Reopens the container's stdout/stderr log files.

methods.name: CheckpointContainer
methods.description: Checkpoint a container.

methods.name: GetContainerEvents
methods.description: Retrieves container events from the runtime.

methods.name: RunPodSandbox
methods.description: Creates and starts a pod sandbox.

methods.name: StopPodSandbox
methods.description: Stops a pod sandbox.

methods.name: RemovePodSandbox
methods.description: Removes a pod sandbox.

methods.name: PodSandboxStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandbox
methods.description: Lists pod sandboxes.

methods.name: PortForward
methods.description: Prepares port forwarding for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: UpdatePodSandboxResources
methods.description: Updates resources for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ContainerStats
methods.description: Retrieves stats for a container.

methods.name: ListContainerStats
methods.description: Lists stats for all containers.

methods.name: PodSandboxStats
methods.description: Retrieves stats for a pod sandbox.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxStats
methods.description: Lists stats for all pod sandboxes.

methods.name: ListMetricDescriptors
methods.description: Gets metric descriptors for metrics.

methods.name: ListPodSandboxMetrics
methods.description: Lists metrics for all running pods.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the status of the runtime.

methods.name: RuntimeConfig
methods.description: Returns runtime configuration information.

methods.name: UpdateRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Updates runtime configuration.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down the internal gRPC client connection.

methods.name: ListImages
methods.description: Lists existing images.

methods.name: ImageStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of an image.

methods.name: PullImage
methods.description: Pulls an image with authentication.

methods.name: RemoveImage
methods.description: Removes an image.

methods.name: ImageFsInfo
methods.description: Returns filesystem info for image storage.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Shuts down the internal gRPC client connection for image manager.
